description: This PHP class defines a data model 'ClaimAttachmentModel' used within the OrangeHRM claim module API. It serializes claim attachment data for API responses, including attachment file details and employer information, utilizing traits for model behaviors and user authentication.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentModel
classes.description: A data model class for representing claim attachment data in the API response, including attachment file details and information about the associated employee.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a given PartialClaimAttachment entity, setting up filters and attribute names for serialization.
